contract.scope: T1 normative fixtures and result contract only; no theory engine is implemented or certified by corpus-integrity tests.
contract.input: text is an exact source slice. parseChord requires chordSymbol context (default); lyric context is ambiguous. No document parser or persistence behavior is changed.

statuses.unsupported: No partial interpretation. Preserve originalText and preservedText; normalized=null; notes/spellings/classes are empty. category and reason are stable machine-readable codes, not permission to discard source.

contract.note: SpelledNote uses uppercase letter A..G, accidental integer -2..2, canonical ASCII spelling and pitchClass 0..11 with C=0. Accept ASCII b/#, Unicode flat/sharp/natural and double-flat/double-sharp; no mixed accidentals. parseNote accepts lowercase and optional integer octave; octave absent means midi=null.
contract.interval: Signed diatonicSteps count letter moves: unison=0, second=1, octave=7. semitones is signed chromatic displacement; compound intervals keep both integers. Quality is mandatory (P/M/m/A/d). No key inference.
contract.chord: quality is major/minor/diminished/augmented/suspended2/suspended4; seventh is null/major/minor/diminished. intervals include root [0,0] and match notes order; intervals are authoritative, not steps to apply a second time. extensions list included named degrees; alterations list explicit extension modifiers; omissions is empty in v1.
contract.tones: notes are the complete theoretical root-ordered chord tones, not a playable voicing. 9/11/13 include lower odd extensions and seventh; add9 does not imply seventh. Explicit 7#11 does not imply 9. Enharmonic spelling is diatonic, even when it requires a double accidental; do not sort by pitch class or deduplicate by letter.
contract.bass: Slash note is separate from notes. bassRole chordTone requires exact diatonic spelling present in notes; inversion is its zero-based index in this root-ordered theoretical tone set. This denotes a symbolic bass relation, not a measured voicing. Non-chord bass gives nonChordTone/inversion=null; absent bass is unspecified/null. Numeric /9 is extension syntax, not bass.
contract.results: originalText is never normalized. normalized.canonicalSymbol (chords) and note.spelling are in-memory canonical labels only. diatonicSpellings and pitchClasses are parallel projections of notes. No automatic rewriting of persisted charts.
contract.transposition: diatonic uses explicit signed interval and preserves letter movement, not an inferred key. chromaticSharps uses signed semitones and a sharp root preference while retaining diatonic chord-tone spelling. A transposition that requires >double accidental is unsupported. Octave-free notes remain octave-free. No actual engine is called by normative cases.
contract.sections: cases are normative future-engine vectors. legacyNotation is the unchanged 34-case R17 text corpus. legacyProbes are current parser observations, tested separately, and can intentionally differ from future normative semantics.
